plan.title: Issue drawer: conversation first, with a compact pipeline strip and a Skills tab
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One drawer redesign with an approved mockup and a single PRD. 19 of the 36 scoped files are source files, all under src/dashboard/frontend/src (components plus lib/store.ts and lib/agentConversation.ts); the rest are their tests, three doc files and the CI test list. Splitting into sibling issues would ship drawer states the mockup never approved (a strip without the composed layout, a Skills tab without a body) and the pieces only become observable once composed in IssueDetail drawer density. The xBRIEF already splits the work into 21 items that are green at their own commits.

narratives.Problem: The issue drawer opens on the conversation but gives it about 660px of a 980px drawer and loses about 250px of height to chrome: a block above the header, a 52px header, a tall phase rail plus four specialist cards on every tab, a 320px right status rail, and a footer action bar. Skill settings hide inside a disclosure on the Overview tab.
narratives.Proposal: In IssueDetail density "drawer" only: a one-row header (id, title, state badge, cost, the existing IssueActionMenu primary strip, Issue link, close) and no footer; a 34px pipeline strip (six phases that open their agent's conversation, a checks chip, and a strip variant of PickupGateControls); tabs reordered conversation-first with stable ids (Conversation, Tasks, Plan map, Files, Activity, Artifacts, Skills, Details); a full-width Conversation tab with a header row, meta row and agent menu in DrawerAgentSession's new conversation-header layout; a new Skills tab hosting SkillOverridesPanel; a two-column Details tab that absorbs the right rail. New pieces live under components/issue-view so the cockpit can adopt them later. Every DENSITY_SECTIONS.console marker keeps a visible home, proven per tab by a test.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No edit to the cockpit (components/Stage/cockpit/IssueMissionControl.tsx) and no adoption of the new components there.
- No change to the composition of IssueDetail density "page" or "rail" (shell, 360px rail, toolbar DrawerAgentSession with <select>, Overview body with IssueSkillsSection and TasksPanel).
- No edit to components/IssueActionMenu/*, components/chat/ConversationPanel.tsx, the body of SkillOverridesPanel.tsx, or the full variant JSX of PickupGateControls.
- No redesign of the skill rows (PAN-5245) and no work on the slow /api/skills/overrides endpoint (PAN-5238).
- No server, route, contract, store-shape change, new endpoint or new polling loop; no no-loss-matrix.ts row.
- No row added to or removed from ISSUE_VIEW_INVENTORY or DENSITY_SECTIONS; no tab id renamed.
- No mockup-only features: no Test "skip" state, no Synthesis chip, no About/Bookmarks/Copy buttons, no "Not planned yet" strip text, no sample data.
- No change to the closed-drawer store value { issueId: null, tab: "overview" }.
- No raise of scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt and no edit of lib/__tests__/conformance-gates.test.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Lower the existing PRD as written; no operator questions.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD records D-1..D-16 as final, was verified against HEAD 7ece197612f (no frontend drift since its baseline dafeeaf8a7d), and auto mode forbids AskUserQuestion.

autoDecisions.summary: Hide the Skills tab in every density until compose-drawer.
autoDecisions.rationale: ISSUE_DETAIL_TABS gains "skills" in tabs-order-labels, but its body exists only after compose-drawer; hiding it keeps every commit free of a bodiless tab.

autoDecisions.summary: Move each test edit to the item whose code breaks or enables it.
autoDecisions.rationale: The no-loss Skills table needs the Skills body (compose-drawer); most WI-10 IssueDrawer.test.tsx rows and the 905 marker test break at the composition step, so drawer-test-migration owns them.

autoDecisions.summary: Land the Escape defaultPrevented guard as its own item before compose-drawer.
autoDecisions.rationale: Once popovers render in the drawer, an unguarded window listener would close the drawer on Escape inside a popover.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove the IssueView console StartAgentCta block only after the Conversation tab owns the start surface.
autoDecisions.rationale: Removing it earlier would leave the drawer with no start or resume control.

autoDecisions.summary: One late item owns scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt and the four-file main checkpoint.
autoDecisions.rationale: Seven items each appending a line would create seven shared-mutation edges for one file.

autoDecisions.summary: visual-evidence commits the strip fallback or an empty commit recording the check results.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan task done requires a pushed commit with the Item: trailer, and the screenshots live in gitignored .tmp/.

autoDecisions.summary: Split WI-1, WI-2, WI-6, WI-7 and WI-10 into finer items.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each half is independently reviewable and testable; the planning contract asks for the smallest defensible items.
